settings.label: PIN length (digits)
settings.help: Enrolled PINs must have this length.

authMethod.name: PIN on a shuffled keypad
authMethod.description: A numeric PIN enrolled for the user, entered with on-screen buttons whose order changes on every page. A button carries only an opaque id valid for that page; the server maps it back to the digit, so the PIN digits are never sent as text. This hides the digits from simple form logging, it is NOT encryption: HTTPS is still required. A PIN is a knowledge factor: with a password it is NOT two different factors.
